desc: Implement a segment tree whose node summary correctly computes maximum non-empty subarray sum while excluding spans consisting only of deleted positions.
For every distinct negative value, apply reversible point updates to delete all of its occurrences, query the tree, then restore them; establish \(O(n \log n)\) total update complexity.
Prove deleting positive or zero values cannot improve the answer, so only negative deletion candidates plus no deletion are necessary.
Check the segment-tree logic conceptually for all-negative values, one-element arrays, all-equal arrays, empty-result deletion, and deleted values bridging retained elements.
Execute supplied examples and targeted edge-case tests to verify the implementation.
